claim: Risk is a metric used to evaluate MTD (defender-side effectiveness)
quote:
In this section, we utilize four security metrics, (i) system risk
(Risk), (ii) attack cost ( AC), (iii) return on attack ( RoA), and
(iv) system reliability ( Reliability), to evaluate the security of
the cloud after deploying MTD techniques

claim: The mitigation factor is an MTD effectiveness metric (defender side)
quote:
The mitigation factor, denoted by
MFm, shows the ability of the defensive MTD techniques to
impair the attack.
locator: Sec. V-D, Eq. (13), p. 1782 printed (PDF p. 11)

claim: Return on attack is a metric used to evaluate MTD
quote:
Return on attack ( RoA) is a security metric based on the
attacker’s perspective [16]. RoA quantiﬁes the costs of the
attack versus the bene ﬁts of the attack.
